Laetitia Bellmer is a soldier of the UFS, which appears in the Online Universes.



Personality
As the military decides what is right and wrong, she is willing to go along with the most inhumane missions, but she is beginning to question the fact that they sometimes attack private homes and even children.

Laetitia is loyal to his mission and does not show her emotions during them, often analytical of friend and foe. She is also a cool person and does not get excited about things.

Appearance
She has short white hair and blue eyes.

History
Background
Laetitia was a member of the UFS from an early age, where she was trained as a soldier.

One day, as part of a secret mission, she participates in an experiment conducted by the UFS and manifests "Aqua Mistress" an Aqua kinesis skill. This ability was created through research as a by-product of the analysis of the power of anti-demons particles, while she does not use Taima Particles at all, and it takes more the form of an ESP.

From then on, she joins a team that fights against demons and Taimanin, and becomes a soldier who fights in the underworld. Assuming that the military decides what is right and wrong in her affairs, she pursues inhuman missions without sacrificing her emotions, but she is beginning to have doubts.

Timeline TABA
She is seen fighting against the Fuuma Organization multiple times. Hostile as Fuuma Kotaro (TABA) infiltrates certain UFS bases.

Timeline RPGX
Can join either the Independent Commando Unit and assist in the destruction of an artificial Mermaid of the Brain Flayers.

She was assigned as intelligence officer of a small diplomatic mission during the new year of the year of the snake in Gosha Village, under Mirabell Bell. Laetitia Bellmer, Mirabell and Faleila would afterward make a short visit to Mikuruma Shrine.

Timeline Action
Laetitia assisted the Taimanin Task Force, in the search and capture of Anemone.


Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Ability formed water lances.

Aquakinesis: "Aqua Queen", can infuse water with her own blood and control it. She is able to form semi-solid water weapons that are able to pierce objects. A single drop of blood can operate about 10 liters of water for about 30 minutes.
